techniques.name: 倒计时与人声起点触发表白文字
techniques.intent: 以准备—倒计时—揭题建立短片节奏，让文字、图片运动和特效共用同一个提示点。

operations: define reveal cue from verified vocal onset
place three countdown captions in consecutive one-second slots ending at reveal
start final message at reveal and end with music
render contain-fit foreground photo over cover-fit blurred duplicate background
animate first photo with explicit position/scale keyframes
add photo transition using explicit overlap timing, then re-evaluate cue anchors

parameters.countdown_entry_s: 讲解1s目标；240.260s UI尚0.5s，最终值未读取

timing.transition: all dependent events recomputed after overlap; avoid caption overlap

outputs: portrait countdown reveal with synchronized independent captions/music/image

pitfalls: 动作名不足以执行，须写位移/缩放/透明度随时间的曲线；原生组合/收拢预设未解出数学。
转场会移动轨道和时长，不能保持过期的文字/音乐秒数。
本次没有试听，人声提示点需实际交付时核实。
validation: 检查one/two/three/最终文字交界无重叠或空缺。
播放提示点前后，确认最终文字/光效与核实的人声起点同步。
验证背景覆盖完整且人物比例自然。

techniques.name: 特效与短贴纸按文字提示点对齐
techniques.intent: 把装饰作为可控局部事件，避免随意贯穿遮挡主体。

operations: schedule one short overlay per countdown caption
schedule final-reveal effect group starting at reveal cue
define local animation phase and trim all layers to common end

parameters.effect_assets: 星河/金粉散落等原生资源；ID未知
parameters.scope: countdown local, final reveal group, optional full-span effect

timing.dependencies: overlay_start/end references caption/cue instead of independent hard-coded times

pitfalls: 同名花字/粒子/贴纸需要资产，通用爱心或粒子仅是替代。
叠层过亮会淹没文字或面部，应审看实际输出。
validation: 首中尾检查透明度、遮挡、边界和资源存在性。

unknowns: 音乐起唱准确秒值、花字/字体/动画/贴纸资源ID未知。
倒计时入场时长讲解与设置过程帧不同，未冒称最终1.0s已视觉核定。
